instrument.engine: headless Chromium via Chrome DevTools Protocol
instrument.method: one pre-document instrumentation shim + one post-load census script per site; scroll pass to provoke deferred work; media queries read from raw stylesheet text via CSS.getStyleSheetText
instrument.principle: measured the computed/rendered result, not stylesheet source

sitesDetail.why: Reference implementation of the dominant React meta-framework; App Router RSC output.
Utility-CSS site: densest source of declared breakpoints and container queries.
Commercial app shell by the framework authors; heavy motion and deferred load.
Industry benchmark for high-fidelity marketing layout and custom interaction surfaces.
Large production app: menus, dialogs, tooltips, virtualization, partial hydration.
Vue ecosystem reference; SSG plus client hydration.
Vue meta-framework with island hydration and route-level deferred load.
Angular reference site; CDK-driven overlay and a11y interaction surfaces.
Compiler-based framework with no virtual DOM; different runtime signature.
Fine-grained reactivity framework; small-team CSS conventions.
Islands architecture: mostly static HTML with selectively hydrated widgets.
Data-router framework whose defining feature is optimistic UI and deferred data.
Older-generation MVC framework; legacy CSS idioms (float, absolute) survive here.
Long-form document page: multi-column, sticky sidebar, deep DOM.
No modern framework: float-based infoboxes, table layout, legacy CSS.
Table-layout control case; proves the instrument reports absence, not noise.
High-traffic news grid: carousels, lazy media, many breakpoints.
Large commerce marketing site; independent of the framework-docs monoculture.
